subject: Human Body
title: Rickets and Vitamin D
description: Learn Rickets and Vitamin D in one minute.

hook.text: In the 1800s, children in smog-filled cities developed bowed legs and soft bones. The culprit: no sunlight.

buildup.text: Sunlight triggers vitamin D production in skin. Without D, the body can't absorb enough calcium.

discovery.text: Rickets softens growing bones. Children with severe cases can't walk properly. Their legs curve under body weight.

twist.text: Fortifying milk with vitamin D in the 1930s nearly wiped out rickets. It's coming back in screen-bound kids.

climax.text: Adults get the same condition, called osteomalacia. Soft bones ache and fracture under normal activity.

punchline.text: Sunlight builds bones. Skip it and they soften.

quiz.question: How did fortifying milk help prevent rickets?
options: It added calcium directly to bones
Vitamin D in milk boosted calcium absorption
It replaced the need for exercise
